meta.dataFix: 2026-08-22: the toggle assertion was impossible. SauceDemo REPLACES the detail page control instead of relabelling it, so expect_text on [data-test="add-to-cart"] could only ever fail once the element was gone. The item_detail note said "REPLACED" in prose, but the replacement selector was never captured and the planner may only use observed selectors, so the toggle was the only thing it could express. Fixed by capturing the post-add state as its own page (item_detail_added) and asserting the replacement.
